Our Craft

Signature Services

Four disciplines, one obsession — a finish that outlasts the drive.

Ceramic Coating

9H / 10H nano-ceramic layers that lock in a deep, hydrophobic gloss and shrug off swirls, UV and grime.

A liquid glass layer chemically bonds to your paint, creating a slick, self-cleaning surface. Water beads and rolls off, dirt struggles to stick, and the finish stays showroom-glossy for years.

  • 9H & 10H hardness options
  • Extreme hydrophobic, self-cleaning effect
  • UV, oxidation & chemical resistance
  • Deep mirror gloss with warranty

Paint Protection Film

Self-healing Pro Shield PPF that absorbs stone chips and scratches while staying optically invisible.

A transparent, ultra-tough urethane film wraps your paint to take the hits the road throws at it. Minor scratches heal with heat, and the finish underneath stays flawless — perfect for high-impact zones or a full-body shield.

  • Self-healing against swirls & light scratches
  • Stone chip & road-debris protection
  • Optically clear, glossy or matte
  • Up to lifetime warranty film

Paint Correction

Multi-stage machine polishing that erases swirls, holograms and oxidation to restore true showroom depth.

We machine-polish the clear coat in stages to remove years of swirl marks, water spots and dullness. The result is crisp reflections and rich, deep colour — the essential prep before any coating goes on.

  • Removes swirls, holograms & oxidation
  • Single-stage to multi-stage correction
  • Restores gloss, clarity & depth
  • Ideal prep before ceramic coating

Interior Detailing

Deep steam extraction, leather conditioning and fabric protection for a cabin that feels factory-fresh.

Every surface inside is deep-cleaned, sanitised and restored. Seats, carpets, trim and glass are treated so the cabin smells fresh and looks like the day you drove it home.

  • Steam extraction of seats & carpets
  • Leather clean & conditioning
  • Dashboard, trim & vent detailing
  • Odour removal & fabric protection
